notes.title: Minor Update 1.5.8
notes.content:
There's a small new update for Hegemony Gold out today. The main purpose was to remove the old (pre-Steam) registration system, but while we were in there we also fixed a crash related to Steam Controllers and enabled cloud saves for those of you gaming on multiple machines.

Let us know if you run into any problems (e-mail rob@longbowgames.com), and if you need the old version for any reason it's available in the Betas tab under 1.5.7 Legacy Release.

tags.bug: - fixed a crash related to Steam Controllers
